Reference 2 is a technical pose diagram ONLY: follow the leg geometry, NOT its colors or drawing style. Red identifies the anatomical LEFT/near leg; blue identifies the RIGHT/far leg.

Far right leg extends BACK towards screen RIGHT, shoe at rear endpoint touching ground.
